headline: Bruno Fernandes will start
body: BBC Sport, 29 Oct 2026 (Josh Lobley): Carrick on clear-the-air talks with Bruno Fernandes — 'He's an important player… He's fully committed to this football club… He's the one that's kind of led the team so well… and he'll continue to do that.' On the captaincy for Chelsea: 'There is no decision to be made on that.' Mainoo has 'done a bit of training'; Šeško out a long period.
